caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table-like object with four turned legs and a rectangular box structure on top. The object is rendered in shades of brown, with detailed wood grain visible throughout the box and legs. The box section has a horizontal seam with two gold-colored hinges visible on the left edge and at the center, indicating that the top part can open. On the right side, additional gold-colored hardware accents are visible near the upper edge and corner, as well as a decorative square element with a small gold-colored detail at the intersection of the leg and the tabletop. The background is plain and uncolored, with no additional objects or scenery, and the artist’s signature, "HENRY MEYERS," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Writing Table and Desk
